items: Scoop leaves & debris out of gutters
Flush downspouts and check they drain
Point downspouts 4–6 ft from the house
Fix sagging or loose gutter brackets
cta_head: Let MyHome handle all four for you.
cta_sub: Call or text 317-440-9258 to book a fall service visit.
